title: Cleave: Severing Guardrails and Auditing Spectral Coupling in Open-Weight LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.27426v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Open-weight Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely downloaded for their strong coding and reasoning capabilities and deployed locally beyond the provider's control. To prevent misuse, developers embed safety guardrails into these models before release. However, we find that these guardrails rely on the residual writing weights to trigger refusals. Based on this insight, we propose Cleave, a training-free attack that directly edits these weights to remove safety restrictions while preserving general capabilities. With Cleave, malicious users can either remove all guardrails or selectively lift only cybersecurity restrictions. Because this selective removal retains up to a 99% refusal rate on other harmful requests and avoids weight rank collapse, it evades both behavioral spot-checks and static weight audits. Across five open-weight LLMs from 7B to 320B parameters, Cleave achieves up to a 67.97% attack success rate on seven safety benc

translated_title: Cleave：切断开放权重大语言模型中的安全护栏并审计谱耦合
translated_abstract: 开放权重的大语言模型因其强大的编码和推理能力而被广泛下载，并在超出提供商控制的范围内被本地部署。为防止滥用，开发者在发布之前将这些模型中嵌入了安全护栏。然而，我们发现这些护栏依赖于残差写入权重来触发拒绝响应。基于这一洞察，我们提出了Cleave，这是一种无需训练的攻击方法，可直接编辑这些权重以移除安全限制，同时保留通用能力。借助Cleave，恶意用户既可以移除所有护栏，也可以选择性地仅解除网络安全方面的限制。由于这种选择性移除在其他有害请求上仍保持高达99%的拒绝率，并避免了权重秩坍缩，因此能够同时规避行为抽查和静态权重审计。在从7B到320B参数的五个开放权重LLM上，Cleave在七个安全基准测试中实现了高达67.97%的攻击成功率。
tldr: 本文提出了无需训练的攻击方法Cleave，通过直接编辑残差写入权重移除开放权重LLM的安全护栏，可选择性解除特定安全限制并规避行为抽查与静态权重审计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Cleave, a training-free attack that directly edits residual writing weights to sever safety guardrails in open-weight LLMs, enabling selective removal of safety restrictions while evading both behavioral spot-checks and static weight audits.
